en.r: Porcupine Mountains Wilderness State Park is a wilderness area in Michigan, United States. It covers 239 km² and has been protected since 1984. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is a protected landscape, where nature and traditional human use coexist.
en.h: A state park in the Porcupine Mountains, or "Porkies", a group of small mountains in Michigan's northwestern Upper Peninsula near Lake Superior. The Ojibwa named them, supposedly because their silhouette looked like a crouching porcupine. Copper was mined here in the 19th century, so the park is a cooperating unit of Keweenaw National Historical Park.
en.ff: It holds the most extensive stand of old-growth northern hardwood forest in North America west of the Adirondacks, at least 130 km².
at: Lake of the Clouds, in the heart of the mountains
Nonesuch Mine, a copper mine worked from 1867 to 1912

pt.r: O Gete Mino Mshkiigan State Park é um parque estadual nos Estados Unidos.
pt.h: Parque de 147 acres sem estrutura no condado de Cheboygan, Michigan, à beira do lago Mullett, com 457 m de orla intocada. A North Central State Trail, trilha ferroviária de 120 km, passa perto da margem. A área foi desmatada e voltou ao estado em 1904 por impostos não pagos.

en.r: Gete Mino Mshkiigan State Park is a state park in the United States.
en.h: An undeveloped 147-acre park in Cheboygan County, Michigan, on Mullett Lake, with 1,500 feet of untouched shoreline. The 75-mile North Central State Trail runs close to the shore. The land was logged and reverted to the state in 1904 for unpaid taxes.
en.ff: Rolling terrain of mixed conifer and hardwood forest; about 35% is emergent wetland.

es.r: El Gete Mino Mshkiigan State Park es un parque estatal en Estados Unidos.
es.h: Parque de 147 acres sin instalaciones en el condado de Cheboygan, Míchigan, a orillas del lago Mullett, con 457 m de costa intacta. La North Central State Trail, sendero ferroviario de 120 km, pasa cerca de la orilla. La zona fue talada y volvió al estado en 1904 por impuestos impagos.
es.ff: Terreno ondulado de bosque mixto de coníferas y frondosas; cerca del 35% son humedales.
